caseName: Karnuth v. United States ex rel. Albro
caseNameFull: Karnuth, Director of Immigration v. United States ex rel. Albro
attorneys: Solicitor General Mitchell for petitioners., Messrs. Preston M. Albro, Charles D. Council, and George W. Offutt for respondents.

opinions.text: The petition for a rehearing is granted. The order entered October 8, 1928, denying the petition for a writ of certiorari in this case is revoked and a writ of certiorari herein is granted.
